name: MPS-16 ver FM1
author: Brent Walker (BeatSmith)
tagline: a MIDI phrase sampler on 16 pads
description: A MIDI phrase sampler in the Earth Science family. Load a MIDI file and it is on the 16 pads at once, sliced by bars, hits or chord changes; play the slices as recorded or as chords, strummed, arpeggiated or in rhythm, mutate repeated chords, and play bass, lead and key changes on the black keys. Early development.
credits: Built on fm1-base by Charles Vestal and felucca-bsp by Leo Kuroshita.
